abstract:
BACKGROUND: This study aimed to evaluate textbook outcome (TO) and identify its independent predictive factors in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) following laparoscopic pancreatoduodenectomy (LPD).
METHODS: Patients diagnosed with PDAC who underwent LPD were enrolled. TO was defined as the absence of postoperative pancreatic fistula, bile leakage, post-pancreatectomy hemorrhage, severe complications (Clavien-Dindo grade ≥III), and 30-day readmission or mortality and a postoperative length of stay within the cohort's 75th percentile. Overall survival (OS) was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method, and independent predictors of TO were identified through multivariate logistic regression analysis.
RESULTS: A total of 334 patients were analyzed, 220 in the TO group and 114 in the non-TO group. The TO group presented significantly higher 1-, 3-, and 5-year OS (p = 0.044). Recurrence-free survival (RFS) was numerically superior, but not statistically significant (p = 0.140). Multivariate analysis revealed that operative time >360 min, soft pancreatic texture, and main pancreatic duct diameter ≤3 mm were independent risk factors for TO.
CONCLUSION: TO after LPD for PDAC is associated with improved OS. Prolonged operation, soft pancreatic texture, and small main pancreatic duct diameter are independent predictors of failure to achieve TO.
key_points_ko: 총 334명의 환자 중 220명이 교과서적 결과(TO)를 달성했으며, 114명은 달성하지 못했습니다.
TO 그룹은 1년, 3년, 5년 전체 생존기간(OS)이 유의하게 더 높았습니다(p = 0.044).
수술 시간 >360분, 말랑한 췌장 질감, 주췌관 직경 ≤3 mm는 TO 달성 실패의 독립적인 위험 요인입니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 복강경 췌십이지장절제술(LPD)을 받은 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 334명을 대상으로 교과서적 결과(TO) 달성 여부와 그 예측 요인을 평가했습니다. TO는 수술 후 합병증, 누출, 재입원, 사망 등이 없고 재원 기간이 짧은 이상적인 수술 결과를 의미합니다. 분석 결과, TO 그룹은 비-TO 그룹에 비해 1년, 3년, 5년 전체 생존기간(OS)이 유의하게 높았습니다. 수술 시간 360분 초과, 말랑한 췌장 질감, 작은 주췌관 직경은 TO 달성 실패의 독립적인 위험 요인으로 확인되었습니다.
title: Textbook outcomes and influencing factors after laparoscopic pancreatoduodenectomy for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma in a high-volume center
